main_text.p: Octobris habet literam D, quæ indicat feriam Iouis, subsequens autem dies nouarum Iduum Gregorij XIII cum habeat literam A, perinde ut 15 Octobris veteris: incurrit in diem Veneris, ideoque Dominica proxima, hoc est, XVI kalendarum Nouembris (Gregorianarum) indicatur per literam C. Quæ omnia ex sequenti tabella percipere licet.
main_text.head: EXORDIVM CORRECTIONIS GREGORIANÆ SVMITVR AB IDIBVS OCT. ANTICIPATIS.
main_text.l: III Non. 5 E | Decem dies exemti vel potius anticipati a Gregoriano XIII Pontifice ANNO CHRISTI 1582 |
Idus Iulianæ 15 A | | A Idus primæ Oct. Gregorianæ.
17 C | | 17 C XVI kal. Nou. prima lit. dom.
main_text.p: Ne autem in posterum a XII kal. Aprilis, hoc est, a die 21 Martij æquinoctium recedat, statuit Gregorius XIII bisextum quarto quoque anno (vti mos est) continuari debere: præterquam in centesimis annis, qui quamuis bisextiles antea fuerint, quale etiā vult annum esse 1600, post eū tamē qui deinceps confeque-tur cetesimi, nō omnes bisextiles erūt, sed in quadrin-getis quibusq; annis primi quiq; tres cetesimi [?]sine bi-sexto tranfigetur, quartus vero quilque 100 bisextilis erit.

page.notes: Left margin carries small reference marks beside the lower paragraph (ornament-like signs, not legible as digits or letters); not transcribed. The brace label in the middle column spans several table rows; it is placed on row 5 for the table layout. "quilque" and "sine" (printed with a long-s-like form) are doubtful readings. The overline bars over some Roman numerals in the table (XIII, XVI) are not reproduced. No catchword or signature is printed.
